title: The Hartmanis–Stearns conjecture
formal: Must a real number whose base-b expansion is produced in real time by a deterministic multitape Turing machine be rational or transcendental, for every integer base b≥2?
context:
Real time means a constant bound between successive output digits. Automatic and pushdown-generated sequences are restricted cases.

This question was found through Wikipedia and compared individually with the existing candidate and archived records. The linked literature provides definitions and background; this import is not a completed research-card review.
why: Connects the arithmetic nature of numbers to an elementary resource bound on computing their digits.
